configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Common settings for every preset. Ninja is not negotiable here; CMakeLists.txt refuses other generators.

configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Optimised, stripped library, same as the previous -O3 -g0 -Wl,-s commands.

configurePresets.name: release

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised build with full debug info.

configurePresets.description: Adds -march=native. Machine specific, never use this for a binary you intend to commit or share.
